To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) video summarisation can be categorised into three broad types: internal, external and hybrid; 2) the most common type of video summary is object based, followed by event based, perception based and feature based; 3) the most common video summarisation technique is based on the extraction of key frames, followed by the extraction of key segments, key events and key objects.
the video summarization techniques and the video summaries are categorized based on the type of information they are based on and the type of functionality they provide.

the video summarisation research literature is dominated by the internal video summarisation technique, and that the video summary research literature is dominated in the number of publications by the object based category, and in terms of the number of citations by the perception based category.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic generation of video summaries.
the problem of video summarisation, that is, the generation of a succinct, condensed and representative description of the content of an original video.
the development of techniques for the automatic generation of personalised, interactive, video summaries that are based upon the analysis of both internal and external information.
